Warlords - This scenario lets players create a random map scenario. Players may choose from 4 map sizes and up to 44 opponents. This scenario can be played against the computer, hotseat, or PBEM. 44 kingdoms have been added to this scenario including Lizard folk kingdom. More to come.

8.6 - ADDITION - Settlers - Warlords Scenario Only - In the districts menu, players have a number of settlers. Settlers may be used to increase a location's population. Depending on the tile the location is located and the 6 tiles around it new resources may be added to the location but this is not a guarantee.

8.9 - ADDITION KINGDOM ABILITIES
  Bow Master - Archer and horsed archers units have +1 range.
  Ingenuity - +1 to melee and range combat when defending a location.
  Hunt Master - +1 to cavalry pursuit.

Upcoming small updates for October
Dwarf, Elf, Orc, Goblin kingdoms will be added to Worlords with new unit graphics.

notes.content:
##v1.01
ADDED players can change the name of a unit by clicking it's name in the details panel when selecting the army or navy
FIXED some scenarios starting turn 5
FIXED dissent not being removed once a kingdom is conquered
ADDED better tool tip on unit traits
FIXED typo in Battle for Blackiron scenario
FIXED undo bug in economy and districts
CHANGE markets 10/15/20 > 35/50/65
FIXED main menu scaling
FIXED disabled actions in selector when fighting enemy heroes
FIXED unit now shows specialty bonuses to base values
FIXED rebels not going away after conquest
